assertions.description: The color() function accepts display-p3-linear as a predefined color space.
A display-p3-linear color survives to computed value with its color space intact (serialized with the display-p3-linear keyword).
color() components are not clamped at parse time: out-of-range display-p3-linear values are valid syntax.
display-p3-linear is a valid rectangular interpolation space for color-mix().
display-p3-linear is a valid interpolation space in gradient color-interpolation-method syntax.
Relative color syntax can convert into display-p3-linear: pure display-p3 red converts to (1 0 0) in the linear space, since the spaces share primaries.
assertions.test: (()=>{const e=document.createElement('div');e.style.color='color(from color(display-p3 1 0 0) display-p3-linear r g b)';if(e.style.color==='')return false;document.body.appendChild(e);const v=getComputedStyle(e).color;e.remove();const m=v.match(/^color\(display-p3-linear ([\d.e-]+) ([\d.e-]+) ([\d.e-]+)\)$/);if(!m)return false;return Math.abs(Number(m[1])-1)<0.001&&Math.abs(Number(m[2]))<0.001&&Math.abs(Number(m[3]))<0.001;})()

assertions.description: The spec's own example pair — color(display-p3 0.591 0.123 0.264) and color(display-p3-linear 0.3081 0.014 0.0567) — paints identical pixels (within 1 byte of rounding) through canvas fillStyle.
assertions.test: (()=>{const paint=(decl)=>{const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=1;c.height=1;const x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle='#010203';x.fillStyle=decl;if(String(x.fillStyle).toLowerCase()==='#010203')return null;x.fillRect(0,0,1,1);return x.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data;};const a=paint('color(display-p3 0.591 0.123 0.264)');const b=paint('color(display-p3-linear 0.3081 0.014 0.0567)');if(!a||!b)return false;return [0,1,2].every((i)=>Math.abs(a[i]-b[i])<=1);})()
